args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested
arrays, affecting fastjson <2.9.4. Bump to 2.9.4, the fixed release in
the 2.x line.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays, affecting fastjson <2.9.4.

## Change
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4` (fixed release in the 2.x line; no other dependencies touched)

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: **passed**

Reviewer: @alex (code owner approval required to merge into main)
